columns.name: To Do
columns.description: Accepted, not started. Azure DevOps requires exactly one incoming column and it must be first.

columns.name: Doing
columns.description: Work in progress. The item limit is a review prompt, not a hard gate.

columns.name: Blocked
columns.description: Waiting on something outside the team.

columns.name: Ready for QA
columns.description: Renamed from 'To QA'. previousNames lets the reconciler reuse the existing column id, so the Work Items already on it move with the rename instead of being left behind on a duplicate column.

columns.name: Done
columns.description: Azure DevOps requires exactly one outgoing column and it must be last.
